title: PaymentExecuteRequest
description: The input of payment.execute: the canonical URI of the invoice the payment pays, which line ⑨ reads and which no second attempt may share while this one is in flight, the canonical URI of the drafted payment to send, and the version of that invoice its caller decided on (step 35's README, decision D7). This tutorial's own schema: §7's example names the payment only, and binds its invoice by a CEL path, which this tutorial does not evaluate in a bind yet. The patterns are the specification's resourceUri; the /invoice/ and /payment/ parts beside it are this tutorial's.

expected_version.description: The version of the invoice that the caller read, and decided on, as for payment.create: line ⑨ checks it against the invoice it reads (step 21's README, decisions 3 to 5). The payment's own version is read under its lock (step 35's README, decision D7).
